object: Paper 3 cheap-gate audit and separate LUNARC training/inference submission path
quantity_of_interest: whether the implementation preserves the closed evidence gate and is internally ready for a later exact gate-authorized submission
claim_boundary: Engineering readiness and negative gate state only. No external annotation, confirmed structural signal, training result, inference result, efficiency result, break-even result, independent review, peer review, acceptance or publication is claimed.

findings.finding: The v2.1 solicitation has zero registered external annotations, no adjudication and no provenance audit. The wrapper therefore returns a machine-readable refusal and never invokes sbatch.

Dependency-aware Jaccard/tag overlap is the strongest implemented parent control. A modern frozen semantic control and faithful applicable skill/workflow parents must be frozen before result access for a publication-level incremental mechanism claim.
All allocated-node scientific and execution gates use explicit exceptions rather than assert, so python -O cannot remove them.
Training and frozen inference have distinct scripts, model modes, resource profiles and exact SHA-256 allowlists; hostile substitution never reaches sbatch.
Comma and newline characters are forbidden in sbatch-exported paths, shell execution is disabled, and tests preserve the refusal path.

The allocated node rechecks manifest/gate paths and hashes, clean subject, account/partition, workload/model mode, batch allowlist, protocol/benchmark/import lineage, bound artifacts, runner, result schema and input weights before creating the FS9 output directory.
Both workloads hash the input weights before and after execution; inference additionally requires model_mode=frozen, while training requires trainable_copy and may not mutate the bound base weights.
The observed route is billy-old to its active LUNARC socket; FS9 root, account and four registered GPU partitions were inspected without allocating compute.
Zero SLURM jobs were submitted. Allocated preflight, training, inference and break-even experiments remain unauthorized.
This iteration adds no performance result and no quantitative figure. The existing manuscript builds with only its recorded nonblocking underfull warning.

required_next: External annotations, distinct adjudication and provenance audit; then stronger-control freeze and the unchanged-threshold cheap confirmatory gate.
